verdict.rationale: Publishing reproducible task-completion benchmarks such as OSWorld is a fair question for a computer-use agent like Simular, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no published benchmark scores, methodology, or reproduction details. Per-template success rates and run counts (simular-docs-23) are an adjacent product metric, not a reproducible benchmark. An open-source agent framework (simular-docs-2) is a building block, not published benchmark results.
